description: The diff overlay of TmModelingViewer: added / removed / changed / layout-only semantic element ids plus added / removed / changed relationship ids (ChangedRelationshipIds is additive in 2.11.0 — a relationship's layout is deliberately not part of the overlay). The viewer never draws an id absent from the model; removed ids are counted by the legend and, with BaselineModel, named in the text alternative's Removed group; ModelingModelDiff.Compute fills every list.
